content: Let $O_t$ , $H_t$ , $L_t$ , $C_t$ be the open, high, low and close prices of an asset in a given day $t$ . Assuming that the daily price follows a geometric Brownian motion with zero drift and constant daily volatility $\sigma $ , Parkinson (1980) derived the first daily volatility estimator
